Title: Histoire générale des Églises Évangéliques des Vallées de Piémont ou Vaudoises, Livre premier
Creator: Jean Léger, pasteur et modérateur des Églises des Vallées, afterwards of the Walloon church of Leiden
Publisher: Leiden: Jean Le Carpentier
Publication Date: 1669
Rights: Public Domain (printed at Leiden in 1669; public domain by date under the project's 95-year rule)
Language: fra
Source: Internet Archive item bub_gb_kzsAtn028N8C, file bub_gb_kzsAtn028N8C_djvu.txt, fetched directly by the library/source-research thread (Era VII session), 2026-10-16; host rights statement: licenseurl http://creativecommons.org/publicdomain/mark/1.0/ (Public Domain Mark); contributor National Library of Naples; no access-restricted-item flag.
Provenance note: Header prepended; the OCR text follows unchanged (no characters altered; the raw file contains 0 long-s glyphs, so no long-s normalisation was done; the OCR renders the 1669 long s as the letter f, left as scanned). Rights basis restated: a book printed at Leiden in 1669 is public domain by date.
Content note: Book I only, of two (this scan ends 'FIN DU PREMIER LIVRE'). Book I argues the valleys' discipline and doctrine have been held from the earliest times without a need of Reformation, and prints the ancient documents and the confessions of faith, ending with what Léger calls the latest Confession of their faith ('la dernière Confession de leur Foy'; its date was not read this pass). The second scan of this printing, Internet Archive item bub_gb_Yf_DYoc9lb0C, is vendored beside it as Book II. OCR sampled at 10/30/50/70/90% and found readable French with long s as f and many broken words and misread accents; second witness for wording until a cleaner scan is vendored.
